columns.name: TN_JOB_CERTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: FA_CERTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Stores the Certification ID of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.CERTIFICATION_ID.

columns.name: FA_SECTION_ID
columns.description: Stores the Section ID of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.SECTION_ID.

columns.name: FA_CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Stores the Content Item ID of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.CONTENT_ITEM_ID.

columns.name: FA_CONTENT_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: Stores the Content Item Code of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CONTENT_ITEMS_VL.CONTENT_ITEM_CODE.

columns.name: FA_ESTABLISHMENT_ID
columns.description: Stores the Establishment ID Code of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.EDUCATIONAL_ESTABLISHMENT_ID.

columns.name: FA_ESTABLISHMENT_CODE
columns.description: Stores the Establishment Code of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_ESTABLISHMENTS_CI_V.SCHOOL_CODE.

columns.name: FA_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Stores the Country Code of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.COUNTRY_CODE.

columns.name: FA_STATE_PROVINCE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the State Province Code of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.STATE_PROVINCE_CODE.

columns.name: REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Stores the Required Flag of the requisition. Derived from IRC_REQUISITIONS_B.PROFILE_ID, HRT_CERTIFICATION_ITEMS_V.REQUIRED_FLAG.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
